errors.text_span: 切片按照从大到小的顺序排列
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices are arranged in descending order of size, but this is not true for their visual arrangement on the chart, their order in the legend, or the order in which they are listed in the description itself. For example, visually going clockwise from the top, the percentages are 15.7%, 13.9%, 6.4%, and 63.9%, which is not a descending order.
